alerts.rationale: The code deserializes bytes received over torch.distributed from another rank with pickle.loads(). Although pickle is generally unsafe for untrusted input, here the input comes from an internal distributed process group member selected by rank, with size/object receives and rank consistency checks in the same trusted cluster communication path. This is a trusted IPC pattern rather than deserialization of external user-controlled data.
